objectives.statement: T7's record is complete and its manifest green: charter, WSJF baseline, live delivery contract, Phase-G review and a published closure review, closed by a distinct approver.

The operations gate executes: an incident is triaged with no write, an approved mitigation reads back, the incident resolves with a linked postmortem, and a destructive call without the tenant's approvals is refused.
The four write verbs are callable and read back; an undeclared verb is refused; a dry run makes no write.
The cluster live proof runs against the deployed service once its operator CLI exists; it is deploy-bound and not claimed before then.

The tranche's members are reworked in the operative order S06 -> S08 -> S17 -> T17 -> T7. S06 is first: it is the only active member and the control plane every other member's checks read, and it carries the workspace-gate blocker the tranche's acceptance waits on. The tranche review decides continue or pause on the evidence.
